title: Derived restriction vanishes away from support
statement: Let X be a scheme with chosen derived categories for module sheaves and their open restrictions [def-pc-derived-category], T any subset, U an open contained in X minus T, and K a derived module-sheaf object whose cohomology stalks vanish outside T. Then the exact derived restriction of K to the over-site of U is a zero object. Quasi-coherence and affineness are not required.

source.place: Tag 0A9A, affine paragraph: restriction outside support vanishes

proof.text: A section of a cohomology sheaf over an open V contained in U has zero germs everywhere, by the support hypothesis. TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext shows it is zero. Hence the restriction of every cohomology sheaf is a zero module sheaf (identity equals zero sectionwise).

Choose a complex representative L of K. The localization homology comparison and the isomorphism Q(L) to K transport zero restriction to every F(H^n(L)), where F is exact open restriction. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso identifies these objects with H^n(F(L)). Therefore all homology of the restricted complex vanishes.

DerivedCategory.isIso_iff shows that the zero map from Q(F(L)) to the zero object is invertible, since its maps on every homology object are maps between zero objects. Thus Q(F(L)) is zero. Transport this through F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the chosen representative isomorphism to prove derived restriction of K is zero.

Restriction vanishing is proved using TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext, ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso, DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors, and DerivedCategory.isIso_iff. KoszulOpenOrthogonality is the existing comparison input, not its transport and construction on an arbitrary affine scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_derived_restriction_zero
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (T : Set X) (U : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) ⊆ Tᶜ)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hK : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K).val.presheaf x))) :
    IsZero (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory).obj K)
